messages:
maria: Heads up — prod rollout for ingest failed. ECR push succeeded but runtime rejected the image due to provenance/metadata mismatch. Logs below.

deploy-bot: Deploy failed for service=ingest env=prod 
error=ImageValidationError: missing provenance-signature for image repo/redwood/ingest:release-2026-03-20 (sha256:af3b9c7e...)

jamal: Is that the same tag we used yesterday? smells like tag reuse (someone overwrote the tag).

maria: Confirming: the tag `release-2026-03-20` points to a different digest than our last-green. `docker inspect` shows labels missing: 
```
ContainerConfig.Labels: {}
org.opencontainers.image.revision: "af3b9c7e..."
cosign.signature: null
```

cecilia: Suggestion: pin deployment to the last known-good digest and roll back the rollout. We should avoid re-pushing the same tag until CI is fixed.

ajmal: On it. Will patch k8s to use digest: `kubectl set image deploy/ingest ingest=repo/redwood/ingest@sha256:9f7e22b4...` and restart. Can someone confirm the last-good sha?

maria: last-good sha in release notes is `sha256:9f7e22b4c...` (from 2026-03-19), that one has cosign signature and build_id label.

alex: Eng-infra looked at the build logs — cosign signing step was skipped after the base-builder image auto-updated and the pipeline's conditional check failed. Pipeline still applied the same semver tag, so tag reuse + skipped signing = this rejection. Root cause: mutable tag + missing provenance.

ajmal: Rolling to digest now. `kubectl set image` applied, canary started. deploy-bot: status?

deploy-bot: Canary update for deploy/ingest: 1/3 pods -> 2/3 pods updated -> health checks passing.

maria: After canary, smoke tests pass. Full rollback (pin to digest) completed and prod back to green.

cecilia: Action items:
- eng-infra: add CI guard to fail if cosign signature missing (block push).
- release-team: enforce immutable release tags in pipeline and add a deny rule for tag reuse for release-* patterns.
- infra: update ECR lifecycle/policy to prevent overwrite for release tags.

alex: I'll open the infra PR for the cosign check and update the build images to pin versions (no more floating `builder:latest`). Also adding a pipeline step to publish provenance metadata to our artifact store.

maria: I'll file the release note: "hotfix: pin ingest image to immutable digest after provenance-signing gap" and schedule a short change window for deployment of the CI guard (low-risk, 15m).

ajmal: :thumbsup: verifying post-rollout metrics. No user impact reported.

cecilia: One more: add an automated check in the deployer that forbids pushing a release tag that already exists in ECR unless it's a signed re-release. Quick guard until policy is in.

maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: @alex and @eng-infra to PR CI check; @release-team to add the change-window and update release playbook. I'll open tickets and link them here.
